title: 2025, Bluffdale City Council Meeting Agenda 02-12-2025 amended

votes.motion: Council Member Aston moved to APPROVE the January 22, 2025 City Council Meeting Minutes and Agenda,as presented. Council Member Wilding seconded the motion
votes.result: The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the Council

votes.motion: Council Member Aston moved to APPROVE the Consent Agenda, as presented. Council Member Crockett seconded the motion
votes.result: The motion passed with the unanimous consent ofthe Council

votes.motion: Council Member Aston moved to APPROVE Resolution 2025-13 - Appointing a Board Member to the Arts Advisory Board. Council Member Austin seconded the motion
votes.result: The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the Council

votes.motion: Council Member Crockett moved to APPROVE Resolution 2025-12- Consideration and Vote Adopting Amendments to the Bluffdale Policies and Procedures Manual. Council Member Wilding seconded the motion. Vote on the Motion: Council Member Wilding-Yes, Council Member Crockett-Yes, Council Member Lord-Yes, Council Member Austin-Yes, Council Member Aston-Yes
votes.result: The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the Council

votes.motion: Council Member Crockett moved to APPROVE Resolution 2025-14- Consideration and Vote to Declare as Surplus a 2.23-Acre Parcel of Real Property located at approximately 1690 West Rock Hollow Drive to Facilitate a Land Exchange with Salt Lake County. Council Member Lord seconded the motion. Vote on the Motion: Council Member Crockett-Yes, Council Member Lord-Yes, Council Member Austin-Yes, Council Member Aston-Yes, Council Member Wilding-Yes
votes.result: The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the Council

votes.motion: Council Member Crockett moved to APPROVE Ordinance 2025-03- Consideration and Vote on Compensation Increase for Municipal Officers. Council Member Wilding seconded the motion. Vote on the Motion: Council Member Lord-Yes,Council Member Austin-No,Council Member Aston-Yes, Council Member Wilding-Yes, Council Member Crockett-Yes

Council Member Aston moved to ADJOURN the City Council Meeting and move into a Closed Meeting for the purpose of discussing property acquisition and litigation. Council Member Austin seconded the motion. Vote on the Motion: Council Member Austin-Yes, Council Member Aston-Yes, Council Member Wilding-Yes, Council Member Crockett-Yes, Council Member Lord-Yes
votes.result: The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the Council

votes.motion: Council Member Aston moved to ADJOURN. Council Member Austin seconded the motion
votes.result: The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the Council
